title: Stiq: Decentralized Social Networking for Civil Society
excerpt: Stiq is an innovative Nostr client and relay built to empower communities without sacrificing individual control. Developed by the BKF community with AI assistance, it sets a new standard for open, decentralized communication in civil society.
description: Stiq: an open-source Nostr client and relay for civil society. Decentralized social networking with data sovereignty. Built by BKF community, for communities.
